items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: I'm quite sure it was Gaudet playing trumpet.

ctx.x: Yeah. I knew his brother much, pretty well. Let me see. I'm quite sure it was Gaudet playing trumpet. What's the name again? Gaudet. Gaudet. I don't see if I can make it anymore. Is he still around?
No, he's dead. I didn't think about it. He died.
